keyEvents.text: Goal! Juárez 1, Querétaro 0. Óscar Estupiñán (Juárez) header from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Juárez 2, Querétaro 0. Madson (Juárez) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Denzell García following a fast break.
First Half ends, Juárez 2, Querétaro 0.
Mateo Coronel (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card.
Guilherme Castilho (Juárez) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Querétaro. Jesús Arellano replaces Bernardo Parra.
Lucas Abascia (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Querétaro. Bayron Duarte replaces Enzo Giménez.
Substitution, Juárez. Jairo Torres replaces Guilherme Castilho.
Substitution, Juárez. Luca Martínez Dupuy replaces Óscar Estupiñán.
Substitution, Juárez. José Luis Rodríguez replaces Madson.
Delay in match because of an injury Sebastián Jurado (Juárez).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Querétaro. Paulo Victor replaces Denilson Muñoz.
Substitution, Querétaro. Waldo Madrid replaces Iker Benito.
Goal! Juárez 3, Querétaro 0. José Luis Rodríguez (Juárez) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Juárez. Jan Carmona replaces Francisco Nevárez.
Substitution, Querétaro. Eduardo Pérez replaces Carlo García.
Goal! Juárez 3, Querétaro 1. Alí Ávila (Querétaro) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mateo Coronel.
Substitution, Juárez. Jesús Murillo replaces Denzell García.
